record.question: Before placing on slide, tissue sections are floated in water bath at a temperature of:
record.explanation: Answer A: 40-50°C. Paraffin sections are commonly floated around 40–45°C to flatten them, but the optimal bath temperature is set relative to the particular wax melting point and tissue. Source/context note: Prefer a validated temperature for the paraffin used, typically about 5–10°C below its melting point. Reference: https://www.uth.edu/cgc/assets/downloads/cg000578-demonstrated-protocol-xeniuminsituprotocols-ffpe-tissue-preparation-guide-reve.pdf; https://extranet.who.int/lqsi/sites/default/files/attachedfiles/LQMS%202.Facilities%20and%20Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
